⚠️ This repository is a **read-only mirror** — every file is generated from
AgentMore's main tree and republished on every release, so a merge here would be
overwritten by the next sync.

Your PR is still read and still welcome: it is the clearest way to show a fix.
It gets applied upstream and lands here on the following sync.

- [ ] The skill's frontmatter `name:` still matches its directory
- [ ] No internal hostname, path or credential in the diff
